sections.title: Acceptance
sections.text: By creating an account or using Achados e Devolvidos, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: Use of the platform
sections.text: The platform is for registering and searching lost or found items. Posting false, offensive or infringing content is prohibited.

sections.title: Responsibilities
sections.text: Contact and return happen directly between people. The platform does not guarantee the recovery of any item.

sections.title: Changes
sections.text: These terms may be updated at any time. Continued use means you accept the current version.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.text: We collect your name, email and, optionally, phone, city and profile photo, plus the details of the items you register.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.text: We use your data to maintain your account, display your items and send notifications according to your preferences.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.text: Your email only appears on items you published if the option is enabled in your profile. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can edit your data or delete your account at any time in the user area.

help.title: How can we help?
help.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions.
help.contactText: Send us a message and we will reply as soon as possible.

items.q: How do I register a lost or found item?
items.a: Sign in, click "Register item" and fill in the details. Photos and a good description increase the chances of a return.

items.q: How do I contact the person who found (or lost) an item?
items.a: Open the item details and use the contact button. You fill in your details and send a message to the owner's email.

items.q: How do I edit or delete an item?
items.a: In the user area, open "My items", click the three dots on the item and choose "Edit item".

items.q: I forgot my password. What now?
items.a: On the login page, use the password recovery option. We will email you a link to create a new password.

items.q: Can I hide my email on items?
items.a: Yes, but to keep your items published and visible to everyone, you must keep the email display option enabled. If you want to hide your email, you’ll need to delete your published items before turning off this option under "My profile", in the preferences section.
